gloss: a part; a portion; a section

definitions.gloss: a part; a portion; a section
definitions.explanation: A fraction or segment of a larger whole. More explicit than 一部, emphasizing that the item in question is literally one section of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部分|いちぶぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない。
examples.english: This is only a part of the whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部分|いちぶぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れていた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: A section of the wall was broken.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部分|いちぶぶん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: The company covers a portion of the cost, so the amount I pay out of pocket is small.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (part). While ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧ is the more common and shorter synonym, {一部分|いちぶぶん} is slightly more formal and emphasizes the physical or conceptual segment more concretely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一部分|いちぶぶん}: a part of the whole
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{一部分|いちぶぶん}: just a small portion
- {一部分|いちぶぶん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: only a portion
- {一部分|いちぶぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧: to make up a portion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧: a part — more common in everyday speech and writing; often interchangeable
- ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: a part, portion — more general and does not specify "one" section
- ⟦{一端|いったん}→一端：11384_ittan⟧: one end, a part — emphasizes a glimpse or aspect rather than a physical section
